meta.strategy: Economic: every build is an investment. Spend resources on the right things, in the right order, to save time and earn more.
meta.pillar: Restoration + completion: the castle visibly grows and the frost recedes; the Hearthbook tracks completion.
meta.social: Growth has a purpose: a stronger castle holds off raids, and your heroes are worth lending to friends.
meta.oneSentence: Rebuild a frozen castle. Spend smart so it pays you back. Guard it, and your friends', against the frost.
meta.note: Supersedes game-data-simple.json v1.0. Houses become a castle; furniture-recipe rooms become castle buildings; fur becomes gold; Hearth Level becomes Castle Level.
meta.characters: Heroes are true 3D voxel models (separate work). Names used here: Hearthguard, Pinewarden, Emberwright, Rime Brute; enemies Frostling, Frost wolf, Rime ghoul, Rime Troll.

harvestNodes.note: beside each ruin; gone once picked

stone_wall.name: Stone wall
stone_wall.effect: One block of wall, one cube high. Two mined stone make one placed cube.
stone_wall.artPrompt: a single straight section of crenellated fieldstone castle wall with a timber walkway, frost in the cracks

gatehouse.effect: The way in. Walls joined to the gatehouse make the courtyard: anything inside is safe from frosting.
gatehouse.artPrompt: a small stone gatehouse with a heavy timber portcullis gate, two squat flanking turrets, iron studs

watchtower.name: Watchtower
watchtower.effect: A lookout with a bowman. It shoots wolves, bears and raiders within 12 m, day and night. Needs a quarry.
watchtower.artPrompt: a tall square timber watchtower on a stone base with a roofed archer platform and a ladder

ember_brazier.name: Ember brazier
ember_brazier.effect: At night, burns frost creatures within 3 m for 4 dmg/s. Also a light source.
ember_brazier.artPrompt: a stone-and-iron brazier on three legs with a glowing bed of orange ember shards and rising sparks

woodcutter.name: Woodcutter's lodge
woodcutter.effect: A woodcutter's hut. It brings in wood on its own. Needs your cottage first.
woodcutter.artPrompt: a small log lodge with a chopping block, a stacked woodpile and a big axe in a stump

quarry.name: Quarry
quarry.effect: Cuts stone for you, steadily. Needs a woodcutter's hut first.
quarry.artPrompt: a small stone quarry cut into a grey rock face with a timber crane, a rope and a pile of cut blocks

mine.effect: Built on the iron outcrop in the Iron Hills (outside the walls). Produces iron.
mine.artPrompt: a timber-framed mine entrance in a rusty hillside with a small ore cart on rails and a lantern

great_hall.name: Great Hall
great_hall.effect: Feasts and taxes: produces gold. A seat at the table: the Emberwright joins once it stands.
great_hall.artPrompt: a long stone great hall with a steep timber roof, carved door posts, warm light in tall windows and a banner

chapel.name: Hearth chapel
chapel.effect: A small fire-shrine: produces ember shards (the only steady source besides raids). Heroes wake 3 s faster.
chapel.artPrompt: a tiny stone chapel with a round window glowing ember orange, a bell in a small timber bellcote, snow on the roof

storehouse.name: Storehouse
storehouse.effect: Holds far more of everything. Needs a quarry first.
storehouse.artPrompt: a sturdy stone storehouse with a timber loft, barrels, sacks and crates under a sloped roof, iron-bound door

smithy.name: Smithy
smithy.effect: Forge + anvil. Crafts the Iron sword. Every upgrade costs 25% less once it stands.
smithy.artPrompt: a stone smithy with an open front, a glowing forge with bellows, an anvil on a stump and tools on the wall

ember_forge.name: Ember forge
ember_forge.effect: Crafts the Ember brand. Kin weapons turn to ember.
ember_forge.artPrompt: a black-iron forge with glowing ember-shard inlays, roaring gold-orange fire and floating sparks

barracks.name: Barracks

dirt.name: Dirt block

gate.name: Gate
gate.effect: A solid gate, four squares wide, with an arch. You walk through; creatures do not. Press R to turn it.
gate.artPrompt: a small wooden fort gate with sharpened posts

blacksmith.effect: A forge for weapons. Needs a quarry first. Iron comes from the Iron Hills, far from home.
blacksmith.artPrompt: a stone blacksmith workshop with a chimney

stone_gate.name: Stone gate
stone_gate.effect: A stone arch with a great timber drawbridge. Needs a blacksmith (iron fittings). Click it to lower the bridge. A bear can batter the bridge down; a deep pit in front keeps it away.
stone_gate.artPrompt: a stone castle gate arch with a raised timber drawbridge

cottage.name: Cottage
cottage.effect: Your home. Sleep here, keep your door, and stay out of the cold. Build it anywhere you like, whenever you like, but build it first.
cottage.artPrompt: a small timber cottage with a thatched roof

fire_pot.name: Fire pot
fire_pot.effect: A pot of burning coals. Lights up your camp at night, and standing near it keeps the cold off.
fire_pot.artPrompt: an iron fire pot on a stone base

farm.name: Farm
farm.effect: A barn for a farmer. Draw wheat fields around it (Wheat field, in the drawer): the bigger the field, the more wheat.

field.name: Wheat field
field.effect: One square of tilled field, sown with wheat. Draw it within 14 m of a farm. It grows sprout, green, gold, then gives 1 wheat and starts again.

silo.name: Grain silo
silo.effect: Stores up to 200 wheat. Wheat goes here first; the marketplace takes what does not fit.

market.name: Marketplace
market.effect: Your storehouse and shop. Carts bring everything your town makes here, and you can watch the crates pile up.

keepUpgrade.name: Heartfire hearth
keepUpgrade.effect: Bind the troll's warm heart into the Keep's hearth. Castle Level can reach 5: the whole map thaws.

upgradeRules.levels: producers, Storehouse and Barracks have a Level 2. Nothing else levels in v1.
upgradeRules.smithyDiscount: with a Smithy, every Level 2 upgrade costs 25% less (rounded up per resource)
upgradeRules.upgradeTime: instant (no build timers in v1: timers are friction)
upgradeRules.points: upgrades add no castle points; they are pure economy

paybackRule.formula: paybackMin = sum(cost x valueSec) / sum(production per min x valueSec)
paybackRule.shownAs: the Build card says, e.g., '+6 wood/min. Pays for itself in 1.7 min.'
paybackRule.storehouseShownAs: '+100 storage. Guards half your stores from raids.'
paybackRule.liveGameNote: demo rates are tuned for a 15-minute session. A persistent v2 castle runs the same table per 10 minutes instead of per minute, so offline production fills the caps in hours, not minutes.

ruinRules.repairClick: click a broken piece: it shows the repair cost; a second click repairs it with a pop and a puff of snow
ruinRules.restoredTick: a restored ruin ticks the Hearthbook and its snow cap slides off

castleLevel.score: sum(castlePoints of each DISTINCT piece type you have built or restored inside the glow)
castleLevel.rule: CL = min(highest threshold reached, hearthCap). Unlit Keep = CL 0. CL5 needs the Heartfire hearth.
castleLevel.glowRule: you can build only inside the glow (except the Iron mine on its outcrop); the glow edge melts snow as it grows
castleLevel.capMessage: The hearth burns as bright as it can. Something warmer waits at the bridge.

heroes.growth: Secondary by design. A hero's level IS your Castle Level (HP + attack bonus from the table) plus its best weapon. No XP, no skill tree.
heroes.why: Hero power exists so a friend's hero is worth borrowing: a CL4 hero with an Iron sword (power 26) is a real defender for a CL2 friend.

ember_brand.name: Ember brand
ember_brand.burn: frost creatures burn 3 dmg/s for 3 s

combat.damage: max(1, atk - defense) per hit; no armour in v1
combat.heroDown: at 0 HP a hero wakes by the Keep after 5 s (2 s with a Chapel). Nothing is lost.

phases.note: no timer; no more raids in the demo

dayNight.bell: ring the Keep bell to start dusk early
dayNight.duskWarning: 30 s before dusk: horn, amber sky, goal line 'Dusk soon: man the walls'
dayNight.productionAtNight: producers keep producing at night unless frosted

rules: Raiders walk in a straight line from the frost edge toward the Keep (no pathfinding); whatever blocks them, they attack.
Inside the glow, frost creatures take thawDps(CL) every second: a bigger castle burns them faster.
Towers, braziers, your hero and your kin fight automatically; click a raider to send the hero after it.
A raider that touches a producer outside the courtyard FROSTS it: it makes nothing for the rest of the night and the first 60 s of the next day. Walls protect income.
Win (timer runs out): dawn, the frost recedes and opens the next zone; broken walls rebuild for free.

Lose (Keep HP hits 0): the fire gutters but never goes out. The frost takes 10% of your UNPROTECTED stores (a Storehouse guards half). No building is ever destroyed. The next day is 90 s long so you can try again.
aiRaids.thawTargetsNote: the glow damages at most 3 raiders at once in the validator's model (raiders arrive in a stream)

enemies.name: Rime Troll
enemies.pattern: slow club swing every 2 s; every third swing a ground slam with a 1 s glowing ring telegraph (step out); at half HP it roars and frost wisps fall off

pvp.phase: v2 (after the hackathon). Not in the demo.
pvp.model: Async, Clash-of-Clans style: you attack another player's SAVED castle. They are not online and never see it live.
attackerInput: pick an entry side (N, E, S or W)
pick up to 3 of your heroes

battle.kind: auto-battle: the raid plays itself from a seed. Defender's layout, towers, braziers, walls and guards (including lent friend heroes) fight back with the same rules as AI raids.
battle.authority: the Worker runs the deterministic sim from (seed, attacker snapshot, defender snapshot, choices); the client replays the same seed for the animation. The client never reports the result.

outcome.frostedPct: share of the defender's pieces (by castle points) your heroes frost before time runs out
outcome.win: your heroes reach the Keep's hearth (frostedPct = 100 for loot purposes)

loot.protected: the first 30 of each resource is always safe; a Storehouse guards 50% of the rest (70% at Level 2)
loot.formula: loot[r] = min(perRaidCapEach, floor((stores[r] - safe[r]) x maxPct/100 x lootMultiplier x levelMultiplier)), where safe[r] = 30 + protectedPct x (stores[r] - 30)
loot.lootCreated: loot moves from defender to attacker in one transaction; nothing is created or destroyed

antiGrief.noDestruction: buildings are never destroyed or damaged in the defender's real castle; 'frosted' exists only in the replay
antiGrief.noFriendRaids: you can't raid friends (you guard them instead)
antiGrief.raidLockNote: a castle being raided can't be matched by anyone else for 3 minutes
antiGrief.defenderReward: a defense that holds (attacker frosts < 50%) pays the defender 10 gold from the game (not from the attacker)
antiGrief.revengeLater: a revenge button is a later idea, not v2

friendGuard.phase: hackathon stretch (cloud save) for lending; v2 for PvP use
friendGuard.slots: a Barracks opens 1 guard slot (2 at Level 2): that many friend heroes can guard your castle
friendGuard.lending: you lend up to 2 of your heroes; each guards 1 friend's castle at a time. The hero also stays playable at home: lending costs you nothing.
friendGuard.recall: any time; takes effect from the friend's next raid
friendGuard.fightsAs: a snapshot of the hero at loan time: owner's CL stats + best weapon (heroPower)
friendGuard.defends: AI dusk raids and v2 player raids on the friend's castle

credit.hostSees: 'Held by Jonathon's Pinewarden' on the raid log
credit.lenderSees: a thank-you card with the gold and a Hearthbook 'Shield-friend' tick

friendGuard.friends: add friends with a 6-letter friend code; no accounts, no email

cloud.stack: Cloudflare Pages (the static game) + 1 Worker (TypeScript API) + 1 D1 database. No KV, R2, Durable Objects, queues or websockets.

why.d1: loot moves between two castles: that needs a transaction (D1 batch) and SQL for matchmaking. KV's eventual consistency could pay the same loot twice.
why.noR2: a castle snapshot is a few KB of JSON: it fits in a D1 row. R2 only if replays get big later.
why.noDurableObjects: no realtime: the raid lock is a conditional UPDATE, and the Worker sims a raid in milliseconds.
why.sharedSim: one TypeScript sim module runs in the browser (replay, AI raids) and in the Worker (authoritative PvP)

cloud.auth: anonymous: first launch POSTs /v1/player and gets a random token kept in localStorage (the server stores only its SHA-256). Play starts before the call returns. Optional friend code to link a second device later.

tables.name: players
tables.columns: id TEXT PK, token_hash TEXT UNIQUE, display_name TEXT, friend_code TEXT UNIQUE, created_at INT

tables.name: castles
tables.columns: player_id TEXT PK, castle_level INT, castle_points INT, snapshot_json TEXT, stores_json TEXT, shield_until INT, raid_lock_until INT, raids_today INT, raids_day TEXT, updated_at INT

tables.name: friends
tables.columns: a TEXT, b TEXT, created_at INT, PK(a, b)

tables.name: guard_loans
tables.columns: lender_id TEXT, hero_id TEXT, host_id TEXT, hero_snapshot_json TEXT, until INT, credits_today INT, PK(lender_id, hero_id)

tables.name: raids
tables.columns: id TEXT PK, attacker_id TEXT, defender_id TEXT, seed INT, choices_json TEXT, status TEXT, result_json TEXT, loot_json TEXT, created_at INT, resolved_at INT

cloud.snapshot: { v, castleLevel, pieces: [{id, level, x, y, rot}], heroes: [{id, weaponId}], stores: {wood, stone, iron, gold, ember_shard}, hearthbook: [ids], savedAt }

endpoints.does: create an anonymous player; returns token + friend code
save the castle snapshot (every dawn and on tab close). The Worker re-checks costs, CL gates and caps against game-data and recomputes castle_level.
load your castle (adds offline production up to the caps)
lend a hero {heroId, friendCode}; DELETE to recall

matchmake: CL +/-1, not shielded, not locked, not a friend, not raided by you in 24 h, you under 5 loot raids today. Sets raid_lock_until with a conditional UPDATE; returns the defender snapshot + raid id + seed

body {side, heroIds}. The Worker runs the sim, computes loot with the rules, and in one D1 batch moves loot, sets the shield, clears the lock and writes the raid row. Returns the result + seed for replay
your raid log (attacks and defenses) with replay seeds and who guarded

cloud.limits: rate limit per token in the Worker; snapshot size capped at 64 KB; a raid id expires after 180 s

objectiveRules.optional: upgrades, Chapel, braziers and the full Hearthbook are optional; the Build radial marks the best-payback build with a gold coin

hearthbook.description: The completion layer: a book in the Keep; every entry is a tick box; % complete on the cover and HUD.

laterSections.Raids: first raid won, first raid held (v2)

grokArt.stylePrefix: HD voxel miniature, single object centered, three-quarter isometric view from slightly above, plain light-grey seamless studio background, soft key light from upper left with a warm rim light, crisp cube voxels with subtle bevels and gentle ambient occlusion, cozy frost-frontier palette (pine green, slate grey, weathered wood, rust iron, warm ember orange accents, light snow dusting), no text, no people, no ground clutter, whole object in frame, game asset render
grokArt.charactersElsewhere: heroes and enemies are true 3D voxel models made separately
